sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.html:
NOTES: If you need certified translations of diploma/degree, professional qualification/license, birth certificate, marriage certificate, etc for immigration or other purposes, please refer to our Certified Translation. If not, go on reading.

We believe translation is not only an accumulation of the original wording in the original language, but also a recreation. Translation does not merely stand for an explanation of the original wording, but also represents an expression which is smooth and elegant to the native speakers of the target languages.

For any opaque text and technical jargons, we insist on looking up in the most reliable resources and consult with an authoritative expert in the area of the specialty for any of our translated documents. For complicated translation work we do, we follow the procedure of "translated by one translator, scrutinized by two proofreaders—usually one technical and one linguistic expert".

"Complete, smooth and elegant" are the mottos we follow in all of our translation work.

We offer translation service for over 100 languages worldwide. The above is merely a selection of some of our languages offered.
